description: Eerste Helmersstraat 42-56 (1900): 6 m red-brown brick fronts of four storeys under a moulded cornice at 14.0 m; three axes of wide three-light windows (a broad centre light between narrow side lights) under a top light; segmental heads with white springer blocks and keystones on storeys 1-2, flat-headed low windows on storey 3; white sills; an iron balconette on a white slab on the centre axis of storeys 1-3; a frieze with white vent panels; a pedestal dormer with a pediment and a finial over the centre; round-arched house door

pediment-dormer.note: 42-46, 52-56: one dormer on a brick pedestal with a pediment and an iron finial, centred

door-left.note: 46: round-arched house door on the left axis

door-right.note: mirrored neighbours: door on the right axis

rhythm.identicalBays: every storey: 3 windows with a transom, one width
rhythm.symmetry: upper storeys symmetric; door left or right
rhythm.roofline: moulded cornice at 13.7 m over a frieze with white vent panels; one pedestal dormer with a finial

match.note: Eerste Helmersstraat 42-56 (1900), 5.7-6.3 m; cornice 14.0 (skyline 14.06-14.1) m on the 2023-01-12 strip
